# select_email_alert_destination (Resource)

An email address that monitors send alerts to. It belongs to the organization's email alert integration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "select_alert_integration" "email" {
  integration_type = "email"
}

resource "select_email_alert_destination" "finance" {
  integration_id = select_alert_integration.email.id
  email_address  = "finance@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email_address` (String) The email address alerts are sent to.
- `integration_id` (String) The id of the alert integration this destination sends through. Its integration type must be the same as the destination's. Changing it forces a new destination.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) When the destination was created — RFC 3339 UTC.
- `error_message` (String) Why the most recent delivery failed. Null unless status is `failing`.
- `etag` (String) Opaque strong ETag for this destination. Sent as `If-Match` on updates and deletes so a change made outside Terraform cannot be silently overwritten.
- `id` (String) The destination's identifier in SELECT. Use it with `terraform import`.
- `last_used_time` (String) When the destination last sent an alert or a test message — RFC 3339 UTC.
- `status` (String) The delivery status: `unknown` until the first delivery, then `connected` or `failing`, or `pending`.
- `update_time` (String) When the destination was last changed — RFC 3339 UTC.
